description:
The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to issue Open Market, Request for Quote 36C25226Q0299 for Prevacuum Sterilizer cleaning and Medical/Dental Instrument Inspection, Sharpening, Maintenance and Repair Services, on or around 19 March 2026.
Quotes will be due no later than 27 March 2026 at 10:00am Local Time.
The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 811210.
